rationale: The agent verified the user by email and acted only on the authenticated user’s account. It correctly identified the orders, confirmed and processed the two returns (bookshelf and jigsaw from #W6239298; backpack from #W9218746), and obtained explicit confirmation before modifying the pending order items to the red variant, stating the exact change and price. However, there are two policy violations: (1) The agent updated the shipping address on the pending order (#W4860251) without first restating the exact change and obtaining explicit user confirmation, which is required before any write. (2) When asked for the tracking number of the canceled order, the agent gave a blanket statement that canceled orders do not have tracking numbers instead of checking and providing details; the canceled order #W1154986 in the tools actually includes a tracking ID, so the final information given was incorrect. These issues fail the pass bar.
